scope: Complete original ten-entry bank ledger, provision/covered charge-off/recovery/release distinctions, common-date book-to-economic bridge, precisely defined toy capital inequalities, encumbrance/haircut and dated fixed-plan cash feasibility. Three worked examples and eight exact fully solved exercises, answered teaching/retention and bounded portable lab.

proof_audit.reason: Every transaction has explicit counter-accounts and a zero accounting-identity increment. Current income excludes distributions and the stipulated recovery credit. Cash is reconciled independently. A loan-created deposit and subsequent external settlement are separate transactions.

Covered charge-off neutrality follows from (G-c)-(A-c)=G-A and requires enough prior allowance. The model rejects uncovered charges unless provision was posted first. Cash recovery credits allowance and is followed by a separately justified reassessment, so receipt and release cannot silently be counted twice. The lab excludes negative allowances without asserting they are universally prohibited.

A complete portfolio present value replaces the net book amount; no second allowance deduction occurs. Liability values and common date are stipulated. Positive ratio denominators and leverage floor below one justify cross multiplication. Cash issuance changes both numerator and exposure; deposit conversion does not add cash; borrowing adds debt and exposure.

For this deterministic fixed plan, receipts settle before each cutoff, with no unlisted restriction. Conservation gives necessity and induction gives sufficiency of every nonnegative unrestricted remainder. Up-front cash shifts every prefix equally, hence maximum prefix deficit is the minimum. A later positive projection is explicitly not execution following an earlier failure.

Only free collateral supports the new committed advance. Newly pledged securities remain assets with a corresponding debt, are unavailable for a simultaneous sale and are released only at repayment. Principal repayment is separated from financing interest; the old pledged pool remains unavailable. The alternative sale exercise starts from separate book and economic valuation bases.

limitations: Author and machine-assisted calculations are not independent human academic certification; separate scoped peer and coordinator acceptance remain pending.
All amounts, policy gates, timing and funding rights are stipulated; passed code does not establish actual recoverability, lender performance, capital compliance or legal solvency.

The model uses a positive-allowance bounded asset inventory, complete supplied marks and one fixed funding plan. It omits taxes, OCI, further facilities, collateral reuse, margin calls and unmodeled intraday timing.
Every later forecast after the first failed cutoff assumes all payments solely for diagnosis; it is not an executable unfinanced history. New unsecured repair obligations lie beyond this horizon.
Output rounds to twelve decimal places; finite test cases do not exhaust all inputs. Whole-edition accessibility/mobile/print checks are separately coordinated.
